owner_decision: 2026-10-29, the owner: 'Commit to it and do it. We need results.' on the session's proposal to finish the kill test with 2023 filings; handoff/decisions/2026-10-29_kill_test_2023.md

filings.collection: collected fresh for every quarter, not spliced onto the 2020-2022 file: the stored evidence of that file is truncated at 2022-12-31. COLLECT.json records the cross-check of the re-collected 2020-2022 rows against the frozen events.csv.gz of KILL_TEST_2020_2022.

header: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/<cik>/<accession without dashes>/<accession>-index-headers.html: ACCEPTANCE-DATETIME (New York) and the SUBJECT COMPANY CENTRAL INDEX KEY

statistic.sample: FIRE, status EXITED with at least one scored control
statistic.primary: mean excess, t from 10,000 bootstrap resamples of ISO weeks of the entry session (seed 20261203)

verdict.NOT_KILLED: mean excess > 0 (not a confirmation: survivor-only prices)
verdict.INCONCLUSIVE: fewer than 300 scored FIRE events (no return read)

supersedes.verdict: INCONCLUSIVE (288 scored FIRE events, fewer than 300); that record stands and is not changed
supersedes.why_an_extension_is_allowed: the 2020-2022 run failed the GO rule on counts, so run_v2.py never computed a return statistic and never wrote events_fire.csv: no return of this test has been read by anyone. Extending the entry window before any outcome is seen is an enrollment extension, not a second look at a result. The bar (300 scored FIRE), the statistic, the plan, the controls, the abstention rules and the verdict rule are all unchanged; only the entry window and the quarters collected differ.
supersedes.overrides: the line 'must not be rerun with a lower bar or a wider window' in the 2026-10-28 outcome section of handoff/decisions/2026-10-28c_proof_program.md, on the owner's explicit instruction. The bar is not lowered.

window_end: 2023-12-29, the panel's last session; an entry on 2023-11-30 is the last whose 20-session hold ends inside the panel. The sealed US holdout (2024 onward) is never loaded.
data_is_not_virgin: 2023 is outside the sealed holdout but was used as the validation year of earlier experiments (E2, E5). It is unused by this test: the 2020-2022 run loaded bars only to 2022-12-30. A NOT_KILLED on this window is therefore weaker still; a KILL remains informative.
